name: Default
shortDescription: Generic WebDAV server written in Python that shares a persistent folder over HTTPS with password-protected read and write access.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated wsgidav_password, which is written into the wsgidav.yaml config file (simple_dc.user_mapping). There is no web app: connect a WebDAV client to https://<your domain>/; a browser only shows a read-only directory listing.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
